feed.title: Cardano Founder Charles Hoskinson Backs Clarity Act, Praises Paul Atkins
feed.summary: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson has expressed strong support for the Clarity Act, believing that continued crypto investment and industry discussions can help pass the legislation by September 15. He also praised SEC Chair Paul Atkins for his non-anti-industry stance on crypto, viewing it as strategically important for the U.S. Hoskinson believes that if the Clarity Act passes, it will boost institutional confidence and provide a broader foundation for the next crypto bull cycle.

feed.title: Compatible Verizon phones can send satellite texts as another Hawaii storm nears
feed.summary: Verizon is preparing its network in Hawaii for an approaching tropical storm, following Hurricane Lala, by reinforcing infrastructure, refueling generators, and staging mobile equipment. The company is offering customer relief through August 31st, including waived charges and unlimited usage for eligible customers. Verizon also highlights the use of satellite messaging on compatible devices like the iPhone 14/18+ and Google Pixel 9+ for critical communications if terrestrial services fail, urging customers to familiarize themselves with these features.

feed.title: Mosaic Stock Rises As Analysts Boost Targets And Debt Falls

The company has also reduced its debt by tendering up to $1.4 billion in notes, improving its financial stability despite current cyclical weaknesses in the fertilizer market.

feed.title: Northern Trust stock holds above $180 as new asset servicing mandate and institutional inflows support growth

Despite a consensus "Hold" rating from analysts, the stock's performance above the target price suggests that the market is valuing its strategic expansions and consistent institutional support.

The Levit Green campus, master-planned for nine buildings and 4 million square feet, continues to attract biotech investment, further bolstered by recent multi-billion dollar commitments from Eli Lilly and Bristol Myers Squibb in the broader Houston area.

feed.title: EF1 tornado damages Kraft Heinz plant in Dover
feed.summary: An EF1 tornado caused significant damage to the Kraft Heinz manufacturing plant in Dover, Delaware, on Thursday evening. The storm tore open exterior walls, exposed warehouse inventory, and overturned tractor-trailers, though the full extent of operational impact is yet unknown. The city declared a state of emergency, but no significant injuries were reported, and cleanup efforts are underway.

feed.title: CoStar (NASDAQ: CSGP) pushes into $400B new-home market with latest acquisition
feed.summary: CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) has completed its $800 million acquisition of Zonda, a leading provider of new home construction data, software, and marketplaces. This strategic move significantly expands CoStar's presence in the U.S. new home market, estimated at $400 billion annually, adding profitable, subscription-based revenue and online marketplaces like NewHomeSource.com and Livabl. The acquisition is expected to enhance CoStar's residential segment profitability and overall margin profile, building on its strong Q2 2026 results which saw $925 million in revenue and doubled Adjusted EBITDA year-over-year.

feed.title: S&P Global upgrades Somnigroup rating on lower leverage
feed.summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded Somnigroup International Inc.'s rating to 'BB+' from 'BB', citing reduced leverage after its integration of Mattress Firm. The ratings firm forecasts Somnigroup will expand sales by approximately 2% and further reduce adjusted leverage to about 3.2x in fiscal 2026. The company's proposed acquisition of Leggett & Platt is expected to close in Q3 2026, which S&P Global Ratings believes will be leverage neutral.

feed.title: Public Storage stock holds steady as institutions add positions and Q2 2026 move-in rents improve

The company reported increased move-in rents and confirmed a Q3 2026 cash dividend of $3.00 per share, translating to an annualized yield of about 3.7%. Despite new supply pressures in the self-storage market, Public Storage continues to demonstrate pricing power and integrate its recent NSAT acquisition, reinforcing its stable income-oriented profile for investors.

feed.title: Tesla recalls nearly 3 million vehicles over safety risks
feed.summary: Tesla is recalling nearly 3 million vehicles in China due to safety concerns related to hidden door handles, which could prevent quick escape or rescue in emergencies. This recall is part of a larger action affecting over 4 million cars, including those from Chinese automakers, ahead of a 2027 ban on such door handles. Regulators stated the move aims to unify safety upgrades in the rapidly evolving new energy vehicle industry.

feed.title: Advanced Micro Devices vs. Arm Holdings: Comparing Revenue Trends Between These Artificial Intelligence Companies
feed.summary: This article compares the revenue trends of Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and Arm Holdings (ARM), both key players in the artificial intelligence sector. AMD is shown to have consistently upward revenue growth, driven by strong demand for its AI chips, with impressive year-over-year sales increases. Arm, while growing, exhibits more fluctuating revenue, but is looking to boost future earnings by expanding into semiconductor chip production and increasing royalties from data centers.
